$comment: Cru brand key colours as they stand in the Cru Design System Figma file, by way of the ref layer of @cruglobal/cornerstone-design-system. Update from Figma (or from /pull-tokens output) and re-run tools/palette.mjs. This file is the seam: everything downstream is derived.
$fontsComment: Cru's brand faces, from --sys-string-font-family-* in the design system: Sora for display/headline/title, Inter for body/label/button. Code and longform have no counterpart in sys and are carried from the reference theme.
